+---
+Found in ^k2zn64x. `MLXLanguageModel.Executor.historyMessages` replays reasoning only when `ReasoningConfig.replaysReasoningIntoHistory` is set (Qwen). `ChatSession.ReasoningHistory` also honors `replaysUnclosedReasoningIntoHistory` (DeepSeek-V4, card ^mf1mwaw): a turn that stopped inside the block its prompt opened is recorded as `.assistant("", reasoning: text)`. In FoundationModels such a turn is an empty response entry beside a reasoning entry, and the reasoning is dropped, thus the follow-up render omits the turn and a hybrid model restores to the checkpoint. ^k2zn64x made `TranscriptConverter.mlxMessages(replayReasoning: true)` keep a reasoning-only turn; this card applies that to the unclosed-only protocols.
+
+- [ ] Give `TranscriptConverter.mlxMessages` a replay mode for unclosed reasoning only: replay the reasoning of a turn whose response is empty, drop it otherwise
+- [ ] Wire `historyMessages` to `replaysUnclosedReasoningIntoHistory`
+- [ ] Unit tests in a new file; DSV4 real-model follow-up measurement if a local model exists
+
+#foundation-models #prompt-cache
\ No newline at end of file

+    Implementation notes.
+    - The worktree was created from `main`, not `mtp` (b17ff441 was not an ancestor). The branch was clean with no commits, so it was `git reset --hard mtp` (438974bd) before any work.
+    - Design: `TranscriptConverter.mlxMessages(for:replayReasoning: Bool)` became `mlxMessages(for:reasoning: HistoryReasoning = .dropped)`, with `enum HistoryReasoning { dropped, everyTurn, reasoningOnlyTurns }` and `init(for: ReasoningConfig?)` (replaysReasoningIntoHistory wins over replaysUnclosedReasoningIntoHistory, as in `ChatSession.ReasoningHistory`). `.reasoningOnlyTurns` runs the same replay as `.everyTurn`, then `HistoryReasoning.kept` strips the reasoning from every assistant message with a content or tool calls, so only the empty-response placeholder (the turn that stopped inside its reasoning) keeps it. `Executor.historyMessages` now derives the mode from the resolved config. Existing `replayReasoning: true/false` call sites (TranscriptConverterTests, TranscriptConverterReasoningOnlyTurnTests) were renamed to `reasoning: .everyTurn/.dropped`.
+    - Known limit: FoundationModels cannot tell a turn that closed its block then wrote nothing from one that stopped inside it; both arrive as an empty response + reasoning entry and both are replayed as reasoning-only. `ChatSession` would record the closed case as content. This is the only shape the transcript gives.
+    - No local DeepSeek-V4 model (searched ~/.cache/huggingface/hub and the filesystem), so the real-model follow-up measurement was not possible; the unit tests cover the converter and the `historyMessages` wiring.
+    - Tooling: the `files` tool `replace_all` replaced only the first occurrence each time; edits were repeated and verified with `rg replayReasoning` (0 hits).
+    - RED: the new suite failed to compile without the API; after the converter landed, `theHistoryOfAnUnclosedReasoningProtocolKeepsTheReasoningOnlyTurn` failed at runtime ([user, user]) until `historyMessages` was wired; removing `.map(reasoning.kept)` made `aTurnThatAnsweredDropsItsReasoning` and `aTurnThatCalledAToolDropsItsReasoning` fail. All green after.
